translations.web: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.
translations.bsb: Catch for us the foxes— the little foxes that ruin the vineyards— for our vineyards are in bloom.
translations.kjv: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
translations.asv: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, That spoil the vineyards; For our vineyards are in blossom.
